title: EventDeliveryCheckpoint
description: Progress of an ordered subscriber stream whose offsets are transport-local.

created_at.description: UTC instant of initial durable creation. Server assigned.

version.description: Starts at 1. Increment exactly once per authoritative mutation.

updated_at.description: UTC instant of the latest authoritative mutation. Server assigned.

last_committed_offset.description: Opaque transport cursor observed after durably applied effects.

last_event_id.description: Most recent committed event when checkpoint is from the local outbox.

checkpoint_at.description: Server instant at which the cursor became durable.

x-invariants: Advance by transport order and apply or recognize corresponding receipt first. Sparse events use the explicitly subscribed sequence.
A consumer reset requires reviewed replay plan and cannot erase deduplication state.
